Read inertial measurement unit data

Source: R/read.R
read_g3_imu.Rd

Parses imudata.gz. Accelerometer and gyroscope samples and magnetometer samples are stored on separate lines at different rates, so each row has NA for the sensors not sampled at that time. Lines that cannot be parsed are skipped with a warning.

Usage

read_g3_imu(path)

Arguments

path

Path to a recording folder or directly to an imudata.gz file. Several paths, or the output of list_g3_recordings(), read several recordings into one tibble.

Value

A tibble with columns recording (see read_g3_gaze()), time (seconds since the start of the recording), accel_x, accel_y, accel_z (accelerometer), gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z (gyroscope) and mag_x, mag_y, mag_z (magnetometer). Following the Tobii Pro Glasses 3 Developer Guide, acceleration is in metres per second squared, rotation in degrees per second and the magnetic field in microtesla.

Examples

read_g3_imu(g3_example())
#> # A tibble: 3,835 × 11
#>    recording    time accel_x accel_y accel_z gyro_x gyro_y gyro_z mag_x mag_y
